component.name: IP-DESK-CTRL
component.summary: Encrypted remote desktop with a fixed 10-digit number
Desktop remoto cifrato con numero fisso di 10 cifre

ul.li: Direct connection with UPnP/NAT-PMP port opening, reverse connection and UDP hole punching
Compressed video (H.264, H.265, AV1) or JPEG tiles, multiple monitors
System audio, clipboard and file transfer
Unattended access with password for trusted numbers

description.p: On Linux the remote screen is captured and controlled in X11 sessions.

screenshot.caption: Main window with the number of this computer and the connection history
